about: BATCH 14, ITEM 3 OF THE JOB, the same piece as jobs/the-mistakes-drill-board-is-not-full-size-2026-11-11 (amber flags/amber-553-mistakes-drill-short-fit): the mistakes drill board at 320x568 goes from 302 to 320, edge to edge. A third pairs file for the job, beside the board half's (gates 177 and 178) and the Home Screen app Review's (gate 184). Graded by gate 123 on a trial bundle: both drills entered from Review (three Blunder cards; one Brilliant card), at kunal761 (375x761, ct_safe 51,31), 320x568, 375x667 and the Home Screen app (L.HOME_SCREEN_APP: a 375x761 layout viewport in the 812 shell, real insets 51/31); the five controls on one row (TC-R199a/b), the board's width (TC-R199c), and after a wrong move, a Reset and the right move with its verdict up the board's width and top unchanged (TC-R199d), the controls above the tab bar and no page scroll (TC-R199e). The real code passes everywhere; three ways the fix could come undone are each caught at 320x568. NOT COVERED: a card with motif chips or a goal longer than three lines at 320, a 320x568 Home Screen app with a 20 inset (still fitted to height: 300, was 282), iOS Safari itself, his own look on the phone.

situations.name: his phone in the Home Screen app (375x761 on a 375x812 screen, the shell, real insets 51/31)

breaks.name: drill-board-reserve-counts-the-old-terms
breaks.why: SQ's puzzle height reserve counts the old terms again (8 of top padding an edge-to-edge screen does not have, and the 8 of root padding that sat under the fixed tab bar), so at 320x568 the mistakes drill board is fitted to a height 14 short and is narrower than the screen

breaks.name: drill-padding-under-the-tab-bar-is-back
breaks.why: the root's 8px bottom padding comes back under the tab bar on an upright puzzle screen while the reserve still counts 0, so the column is 8 taller than the screen: the fit loop trims the board or the page scrolls

breaks.name: drill-short-phone-gap-is-8-again
breaks.why: the drill's top block keeps its 8px gap under the top row on a phone under 700 tall, so the stack is 4 taller and the mistakes drill board at 320x568 is 316, not edge to edge
